events.title: Battle of Vienna
events.description: A combined Holy Roman Empire and Polish-Lithuanian Commonwealth relief army, led by King John III Sobieski, defeated the besieging Ottoman forces under Kara Mustafa Pasha, ending a two-month siege of Vienna.
events.significance: Marked the turning point in the struggle between Central European powers and the Ottoman Empire, beginning the Ottoman retreat from Central Europe.

events.title: Battle of North Point
events.description: American militia forces fought British troops outside Baltimore, Maryland. The British commander, Major General Robert Ross, was killed, and the advance on the city was delayed.
events.significance: Helped Baltimore prepare its defenses, leading to the failed British attack on Fort McHenry, which inspired Francis Scott Key to write The Star-Spangled Banner.

events.title: Discovery of the Lascaux Cave Paintings
events.description: Four teenagers discovered the Lascaux caves in southwestern France, which contain some of the most remarkable Paleolithic cave paintings, estimated to be about 17,000 years old. Discovery is commonly dated to September 12, 1940, with some sources giving September 8.
events.significance: The find provided exceptional insight into prehistoric human art and culture and became one of the most important prehistoric art sites in the world.

events.title: Wedding of John F. Kennedy and Jacqueline Bouvier
events.description: Senator John F. Kennedy married Jacqueline Lee Bouvier at St. Mary's Church in Newport, Rhode Island, in a widely publicized ceremony.
events.significance: The couple later became First Couple of the United States, and Jacqueline Kennedy became an enduring cultural and style icon.

events.title: Emperor Haile Selassie Deposed
events.description: Ethiopian Emperor Haile Selassie I was overthrown by the military committee known as the Derg, ending a reign of decades and one of the world's oldest monarchical traditions.
events.significance: Ended the Solomonic dynasty's rule in Ethiopia, leading to a Marxist-Leninist military regime and years of upheaval.
